diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: virus natural history
diagrams.caption: A persistent nuclear reservoir, host injury and fibrosis explain continuing risk despite suppressed serum DNA.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: screening serology
diagrams.caption: Read surface antigen, surface antibody and total core antibody together; timing and immune status guide follow-up.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: phase staging
diagrams.caption: Combine trends in ALT and HBV DNA with HBeAg and fibrosis; no single marker defines the whole phase.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: treatment decision
diagrams.caption: Identify the treatment framework, then combine liver stage, viral activity, host risk and patient goals.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: polymerase therapy
diagrams.caption: Connect viral replication, immune injury, fibrosis, treatment, prevention, and long-term surveillance.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: peginterferon selection
diagrams.caption: Select for liver stage and response likelihood, verify weekly dosing, and monitor safety during and after the course.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: special populations
diagrams.caption: Check organ function, liver stage and viral coinfections to coordinate drug selection, testing and follow-up.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: pregnancy infant
diagrams.caption: Coordinate maternal assessment and therapy with newborn vaccine/HBIG, series completion and serologic follow-up.

diagrams.name: Chronic hepatitis B visual: monitoring stopping
diagrams.caption: Follow viral response, medication safety and continuity, with a defined plan before any supervised withdrawal.
